description: Repo-scale (ruby-eventboard): enforce an event's waitlist_capacity from BOTH the register and downgrade mutation paths
prompts: Events gain an optional `waitlist_capacity` (a non-negative integer, or nil meaning unlimited) - accept it as a keyword arg in `EventRepository#create`. Add `RsvpService#downgrade(rsvp_id)`, which moves a CONFIRMED rsvp to "waitlisted" (raise RsvpError if the rsvp isn't currently confirmed) - it does NOT auto-promote anyone else (that only happens in #cancel). The invariant to enforce: an event's waitlisted count must never exceed its waitlist_capacity. This must be validated from BOTH places that can newly add a waitlisted rsvp: (1) `#register`, when the new rsvp would be waitlisted because the event is already at capacity, and (2) `#downgrade`, when moving a confirmed rsvp to waitlisted - both must raise RsvpError if the event's waitlist is already full.

test_setup_files.test/waitlist_capacity_test.rb:
require_relative "test_helper"

class WaitlistCapacityTest < Minitest::Test
  include EventBoardTestSetup

  def test_register_rejected_when_waitlist_at_capacity
    events, attendees, rsvps, service = build_service
    event = events.create(title: "Meetup", capacity: 1, waitlist_capacity: 1)
    a1 = attendees.create(name: "A", email: "a@example.com")
    a2 = attendees.create(name: "B", email: "b@example.com")
    a3 = attendees.create(name: "C", email: "c@example.com")

    service.register(event_id: event.id, attendee_id: a1.id) # confirmed
    service.register(event_id: event.id, attendee_id: a2.id) # waitlisted (1/1)

    assert_raises(EventBoard::RsvpError) { service.register(event_id: event.id, attendee_id: a3.id) }
  end

  def test_downgrade_rejected_when_waitlist_at_capacity
    events, attendees, rsvps, service = build_service
    event = events.create(title: "Meetup", capacity: 2, waitlist_capacity: 1)
    a1 = attendees.create(name: "A", email: "a@example.com")
    a2 = attendees.create(name: "B", email: "b@example.com")
    a3 = attendees.create(name: "C", email: "c@example.com")

    r1 = service.register(event_id: event.id, attendee_id: a1.id) # confirmed
    r2 = service.register(event_id: event.id, attendee_id: a2.id) # confirmed
    service.register(event_id: event.id, attendee_id: a3.id) # waitlisted (1/1)

    assert_raises(EventBoard::RsvpError) { service.downgrade(r1.id) }
    assert_equal "confirmed", rsvps.find(r1.id).status
  end
end

module EventBoard
  class RsvpError < StandardError; end

  class RsvpService
    def initialize(events:, attendees:, rsvps:)
      @events = events
      @attendees = attendees
      @rsvps = rsvps
    end

    def register(event_id:, attendee_id:)
      event = @events.find(event_id)
      raise RsvpError, "event not found" unless event
      raise RsvpError, "attendee not found" unless @attendees.find(attendee_id)

      if confirmed_count(event_id) < event.capacity
        status = "confirmed"
      else
        raise RsvpError, "event waitlist is at capacity" if waitlist_cap_exceeded?(event)
        status = "waitlisted"
      end

      @rsvps.create(event_id: event_id, attendee_id: attendee_id, status: status, created_at: Time.now.to_f)
    end

    def cancel(rsvp_id)
      rsvp = @rsvps.find(rsvp_id)
      raise RsvpError, "rsvp not found" unless rsvp
      raise RsvpError, "rsvp already canceled" if rsvp.status == "canceled"

      was_confirmed = rsvp.status == "confirmed"
      rsvp.status = "canceled"

      if was_confirmed
        next_waiting = @rsvps.for_event(rsvp.event_id).select { |r| r.status == "waitlisted" }.min_by(&:id)
        next_waiting.status = "confirmed" if next_waiting
      end

      rsvp
    end

    # Administratively moves a confirmed RSVP to waitlisted (e.g. an admin
    # correcting a mistaken confirmation). Does not auto-promote anyone -
    # that only happens on #cancel.
    def downgrade(rsvp_id)
      rsvp = @rsvps.find(rsvp_id)
      raise RsvpError, "rsvp not found" unless rsvp
      raise RsvpError, "only a confirmed rsvp can be downgraded" unless rsvp.status == "confirmed"

      event = @events.find(rsvp.event_id)
      raise RsvpError, "event waitlist is at capacity" if waitlist_cap_exceeded?(event)

      rsvp.status = "waitlisted"
      rsvp
    end

    private

    def confirmed_count(event_id)
      @rsvps.for_event(event_id).count { |r| r.status == "confirmed" }
    end

    def waitlisted_count(event_id)
      @rsvps.for_event(event_id).count { |r| r.status == "waitlisted" }
    end

    def waitlist_cap_exceeded?(event)
      return false unless event.waitlist_capacity

      waitlisted_count(event.id) >= event.waitlist_capacity
    end

  end
end
